anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning correctly.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profits, which may indicate an issue with strategy execution or market conditions.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load average and improve system performance.
Review and potentially restart AI components to ensure they are actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate and adjust trading strategies to improve engagement and profitability.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve any bottlenecks or inefficient processes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to degraded system performance and potential downtime, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Restart AI components and monitor their activity to ensure they are functioning as expected.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can result in missed trading opportunities and lack of strategic adjustments.

recommendations.action: Review current trading strategies and market conditions to identify reasons for lack of active trades and adjust strategies accordingly.
recommendations.rationale: Adjusting strategies can help improve trading engagement and profitability.
